---
name: lexforge-apply
description: Use when a structure check needs the wider body budget lexforge-apply alone gets
---

This paragraph exists to push the body of the fixture past the shared word budget, and it says the same thing again and again because the check counts words and reads none of them. A real skill spends its budget on the rule it enforces, on the table of excuses taken from the runs, and on the list of signs to stop; a fixture spends it on filler.
